description: Resolve one physical U.S. facility and return a bounded, source-reconciled environmental regulatory evidence report covering core air, water, hazardous-waste, and drinking-water programs plus inspections, reported violations, formal enforcement, penalties, freshness, source gaps, and conflicts. Use when an agent needs evidence about one specific facility and wrong-site matching or missing-source inference would be costly; do not use for company-wide research, raw EPA record retrieval, legal advice, or a clean/compliant verdict. Provide frsId or programId when known; otherwise provide name with enough location context to resolve exactly one site. This is a $1.00 USD MPP operation when commerce is active in a released state: identity and state eligibility are resolved before payment, ambiguous/unresolved/unreleased requests are not charged, and the call does not alter regulatory records. A fresh authorized invocation can charge again, while a settled delivery retry should reuse the identical request with the same payment credential to recover without a second settlement.

inputSchema.description: Identity hints for one physical U.S. facility. Provide an exact EPA FRS ID or authoritative program ID when known; otherwise provide the facility name plus enough location context to resolve one site safely. FacilityProof fails closed on ambiguous identity.

address.description: Street address for the physical facility when known. Used only for physical-site identity resolution; do not provide corporate headquarters unless that is the facility being checked.

city.description: City for the physical facility. Used with name/address hints to distinguish facilities with similar names.

frsId.description: Exact 12-digit EPA Facility Registry Service identifier when known. Prefer this over name matching because it anchors federal facility identity directly.

name.description: Facility or site name, including a distinguishing plant/site descriptor when available. For name-based resolution, also provide city/state, address, or ZIP whenever possible.

programId.description: Exact authoritative environmental program identifier when known, such as an NPDES permit ID or RCRA handler ID. FacilityProof uses it to resolve the physical facility before paid work.

state.description: Two-letter U.S. postal abbreviation for the physical facility. Full compliance evidence and permit identity have separate production-readiness rules.

zip.description: U.S. ZIP or ZIP+4 for the physical facility. Use as an identity hint, not as a substitute for a site name or authoritative identifier.

name: facilityproof.check_facility_compliance_evidence

outputSchema.description: Bounded, source-reconciled environmental regulatory evidence report for one resolved physical facility. Missing records remain source gaps and conflicts remain explicit rather than becoming a compliance verdict.

asOf.description: Evidence cutoff or as-of time represented by the report.

conflicts.description: Unresolved disagreements across authoritative records that FacilityProof preserves rather than guessing through.

enforcementActions.description: Formal enforcement-action evidence returned by authoritative sources.

evidence.description: Source-linked evidence observations supporting the report.

facility.description: Resolved physical-facility identity, including authoritative identifiers and normalized location context.

freshness.description: Per-source freshness and observation metadata so agents can judge staleness.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when FacilityProof generated the report.

inspections.description: Inspection evidence returned by authoritative sources in the bounded search.

limitations.description: Important scope and interpretation limits, including that the report is evidence rather than legal advice or a compliance verdict.

operation.description: Canonical FacilityProof operation that produced this report.

penalties.description: Penalty/monetary enforcement evidence linked to the resolved facility when supported.

programs.description: Bounded environmental program/permit coverage found for the resolved facility.

quality.description: Quality and coverage signals for the report.

reportId.description: Stable report identifier for this generated evidence package.

sourceGaps.description: Expected or relevant source coverage that could not be established or retrieved.

violations.description: Reported violation/noncompliance evidence returned by authoritative sources; absence is not a clean-compliance conclusion.

title: Check facility compliance evidence
